frozen: 2026-10-25, before any result of the v2 travel model on Earth or on the map was computed
purpose: Polity v2: ranked places, sea and river transport, monthly seasons, refuge terrain and mounted pastoralists. Free parameters are fitted on Han China (AD 2) and on Mediterranean sailing records; the Roman empire (AD 150) is the held-out test, run once.

earth_windows.note: azimuthal equidistant about the centre (rotclimate.earth.forward/inverse); WorldClim 2.1 5' elevation, monthly tavg/tmax/tmin/prec; land, biomes and the settlement density (settlement base x the central occupation 0.3246) from the Earth land/people run (output/land_people/earth/earth.npz); NCEP/NCAR reanalysis 1981-2010 monthly long-term mean surface winds (uwnd, vwnd, wspd, sigma 0.995)

data.han_counties: Zheng & Wu (2026) Sci. Data 13:876, CountyPointsWithPopulation, YEAR = 2AD: 1,196 county seats and 98 commandery (prefecture) seats
data.han_commanderies: same source, ResearchArea YEAR = 2AD: 103 commandery polygons, 4.09 M km2, census 57.67 M
data.roman_towns: Hanson (2016) OxREP cities, standing in AD 150 (start <= 150 <= end or open)
data.roman_roads: Itiner-e static 2024 (de Soto et al. 2025, Sci. Data 12:1731), all segments without dates or with Lower_Date <= 150 <= Upper_Date
data.polygons: Cliopatria v0.2.1 (Seshat; Bennett et al. 2025): Roman Empire AD 150, Xiongnu AD 2, and the AD 2 / 117 / 150 polities of the windows
data.sailing_times: Casson (1951) TAPA 82: Table 1 sailing times between principal Mediterranean ports (both directions) and the fair / foul wind speeds
data.orbis: ORBIS (Scheidel & Meeks) new_routes.topojson: per-edge summer durations of roads, rivers, coastal and open-sea routes (the route API is closed)
data.season_dates: Vegetius, Epitoma 4.39: sea safe 27 May - 14 Sep, uncertain 10 Mar - 27 May and 14 Sep - 11 Nov, closed 11 Nov - 10 Mar

fixed_from_literature.foot: unchanged from v1: roads 30 km/day (ORBIS foot), minor tracks 25, ferries 40, Tobler x path factor for 7 hours, Soule & Goldman coefficients
fixed_from_literature.sail_note: Casson 1951: 4-6 knots before a fair wind over open water, 3-4 working along coasts and through islands (coastal factor 0.7 within 20 km of land), less than 2 to 2.5 against the wind; square rig tacks at 80 degrees to the wind (100 degrees from downwind). Polar h(theta from downwind) = 1.0 to 90, 0.85 at 100, beyond that the tacking progress 0.85 cos(theta - 100). Variable winds: h_eff = s h(theta) + (1 - s) mean(h), steadiness s = |vector mean wind| / scalar mean speed. Wind strength g = min(1, w / 6 m/s), at least 0.25. Sailing round the clock.
fixed_from_literature.river_note: boats board at a settlement on a navigable river (0.25 day) and land anywhere on its banks; speeds up and down stream from the ORBIS civilian river edges (median of each direction)
fixed_from_literature.season_model: monthly degree-day snowpack (snow below 0 C, melt 4 mm per C per day), soil bucket of 100 mm with Hargreaves PET; lasting snow when the pack holds over 10 mm (as v1); mud = clip((S/100 - 0.75) / 0.25, 0, 1) when not frozen (monthly mean above -2 C), plus the month of snowmelt; mud coefficient 1.8 (Soule & Goldman swampy bog) at full mud on open ground and minor tracks, 1.1 on the marked roads; heat 1 + 0.4 clip((Tmax - 33) / 7, 0, 1); river crossings off the roads 0.1 day, x (1 + 4 flood), flood = clip((Q/Qmean - 1.5) / 1.5, 0, 1), Q the basin-mean runoff; rivers below 0.4 Qmean close upstream travel and halve downstream speed
fixed_from_literature.horse: mounted pastoralists: 50 km/day on level open ground, the same slope shape, forest x 2 and swamp x 2 harder than on foot, snow coefficient 2.0; no roads needed

F1_held_days.data: Han window land: inside = the AD 2 commanderies
F1_held_days.days: year-round effective days -ln(mean_m exp(-days_m)) on the v2 graph
F1_held_days.metric: balanced accuracy over land within 15 days of a seat

F2_ranks.model: a county seat counts as if o_county days farther than a commandery seat; each seat is weakened by lambda x its own days from the capital
F2_ranks.metric: as F1, each at its own best held threshold
F2_ranks.adopt_if: balanced accuracy gain >= 0.005 over (0, 0); otherwise that term is 0

F3_seats.model: polity/settle.place_towns on the model density inside each commandery
F3_seats.metric: Poisson deviance of seat counts per commandery (103)

F4_refuge.model: registered people / modelled people per commandery against the mean 3x3-cell relief (km)
F4_refuge.fit: least-squares slope k of ln(census / model) on relief
F4_refuge.adopt_if: k < 0 with its 95 % interval below 0; refuge factor exp(k x relief) on control

F5_closure.index: storminess sigma = sqrt(wspd^2 - |V|^2) and the scalar speed
F5_closure.fit: two thresholds on sigma (uncertain, closed) that best classify the 12 months (majority of days) under Vegetius: Jan Feb closed, Mar Apr May uncertain, Jun Jul Aug open, Sep Oct uncertain, Nov Dec closed
F5_closure.effect: speed x 0.5 uncertain, x 0.15 closed; also uncertain at a scalar speed of 8 m/s and closed at 10.8 (Beaufort 5 and 6)

F6_storminess_for_map.fit: sigma as a function of latitude and of the month from the winter solstice (bilinear table)
F6_storminess_for_map.use: the map's model winds are vector means: scalar speed = sqrt(|V|^2 + sigma^2)

F7_pastoral.rule: a polity is mobile when the pastoral share of its supported people is above a threshold

T1_roman_extent.data: Rome window land: inside = Roman Empire AD 150
T1_roman_extent.network: Hanson towns of AD 150 + Itiner-e roads
T1_roman_extent.compare: v1 (foot only, no ranks, snow-free season, held 2 days) against v2 with the F fits
T1_roman_extent.metric: balanced accuracy over land within 15 days of a town; AUC

T2_roman_towns_refuge.metric: Spearman of Hanson town area per 2-degree block against model people x refuge factor

T3_roman_town_counts.metric: Poisson deviance of town counts per 2-degree block, place_towns with the F3 fit against 40,000 / 60 km

T4_polity_types.data: AD 117 and 150 polities of both windows

T5_monsoon_sea.place: Arabian Sea off the Konkan coast (16 N, 71 E)
T5_monsoon_sea.expect: uncertain or closed in Jun Jul Aug; open in Dec Jan Feb (Periplus: the west Indian ports are closed in the monsoon)

T6_casson_routes.data: Casson Table 1 routes between ports in the Rome window
T6_casson_routes.season: mean of the May-September sailing days
T6_casson_routes.metric: Spearman of model against Casson (range mid-points) and the median |log ratio|

T7_orbis_edges.metric: Spearman and median ratio of model July sailing days against ORBIS coastal and open-sea edge durations

adoption: The F fits are used on the map whatever the tests show. Each v2 component (ranks, refuge, sea, seat spacing) whose test is worse than v1 is reported and switched off on the map.
